rationale: The badge shows '−50%', and the text after it ('on all seeds this week') does not give the discount, so alt="" hides information nothing else provides.
The SVG is a single grey horizontal line used as a divider, so hiding it with aria-hidden loses nothing.
The alt 'IMG_2041.jpg' is a file name that conveys nothing about the image content, and no reachable description provides it (F30).
The alt describes a canvas garden bag, which matches the image (labelled 'bag') and its 'Garden bag' product heading.
'Demo Shop' is the site name in the header, followed by navigation links, not a title for a section of text.
'Delivery' is a bold paragraph titling the delivery information that follows it, but it is not marked up as a heading (F2).
The title 'Page' is generic and says nothing about the page, whose content is about garden tools (F25).
'Learn more' stands alone in its own paragraph with no surrounding text saying what it leads to, so the destination is unclear.
The postcode field has only a title tooltip, with no visible text next to it, and the button does not come right after it, so keyboard and touch users never see what to enter.
The field is labelled only by a 'Name' placeholder, which disappears once text is typed, and nothing else on screen says what the field is for.
'Demo Shop' is the site name at the top of the header, followed by navigation, not a section title for the text after it.
The title 'Offers - Demo Shop' matches the page's main heading 'Offers' and names the site.
Three mouse-operable controls (the Account menu, the Fern tile and the Cactus role=button) can never take keyboard focus.
The Account menu span has a click handler but cannot take focus, and no focus stop on the page offers the same action.
The Cactus span has role=button but never takes keyboard focus, and no other stop on the page offers the same function.
Focus starts on 'Seeds and bulbs: all offers', a link low in the main content, before the header navigation and the earlier main links, so the order does not follow the reading order.
The Home link was reached at stop 2, and nothing visible changed when it took focus.
The Products link was reached at stop 3, and nothing visible changed when it took focus.
The Cart link was reached at stop 4, and nothing visible changed when it took focus.
The Help link's background, text colour and underline change on focus, so focus is visible even without the outline.
The Home, Products and Cart links show no change on focus, and the Roses and Tulips links are entirely hidden under the header while focused.
Stops 6 and 7 (Roses, Tulips) take focus with coveredShare 1, so the sticky header hides them entirely (F110).
The sticky header entirely covers the Roses and Tulips links while they have focus, so part of a focused element is hidden.
The Home link changes 0 px on focus (atContrast 0 against 244 needed, meets false), so there is no indicator.
The Products link changes 0 px on focus (atContrast 0 against 336 needed, meets false), so there is no indicator.
The Cart link changes 0 px on focus (atContrast 0 against 192 needed, meets false), so there is no indicator.
The Help link's indicator has 584 px at 3:1 or more against 204 needed, and meets is true.
